title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Dream Clown Starter Deck Pegasus SDP-017 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Introducing the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Dream Clown SDP-017 1st First Edition Common card. This card features the character of Dream Clown, a warrior type creature with 900 defense/toughness and 1200 attack/power. It belongs to the Starter Deck: Pegasus set and is an effect type card with a card number of SDP-017. 

This card is manufactured by Konami and is available in English language. It falls under the categories of CCG Individual Cards and Collectible Card Games, and is a must-have for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG. The card is in great shape and is a short print rarity. Get your hands on this dream card and add it to your collection today!
